description: This is the main module of a FastAPI application for poll engagement analytics. It defines API endpoints for ingesting poll events and retrieving poll summary analytics, including database initialization, request handling, and data aggregation.

methods.name: startup()
methods.description: Initializes database tables on application startup.

methods.name: get_db()
methods.description: Provides an asynchronous database session dependency for request handlers.

methods.name: health_check()
methods.description: A simple endpoint to check if the API is healthy.

methods.name: ingest_event( payload: PollEventIn = Body(..., description="Poll event data"), db: AsyncSession = Depends(get_db) )
methods.description: Endpoint to ingest a poll engagement event, with deduplication by event_id.

methods.name: get_poll_summary( poll_id: Optional[str] = Query(None, description="Poll ID to query (aggregates over all if not provided)"), start_time: Optional[datetime] = Query(None, description="Start datetime (ISO8601)"), end_time: Optional[datetime] = Query(None, description="End datetime (ISO8601)"), db: AsyncSession = Depends(get_db) )
methods.description: Endpoint to retrieve aggregated poll analytics, optionally filtered by poll_id and time range.

ctags.signature: ( poll_id: Optional[str] = Query(None, description="Poll ID to query (aggregates over all if not provided)"), start_time: Optional[datetime] = Query(None, description="Start datetime (ISO8601)"), end_time: Optional[datetime] = Query(None, description="End datetime (ISO8601)"), db: AsyncSession = Depends(get_db) )
